docling.verdict: Open-source Python library that converts messy PDFs and office docs into clean, structured Markdown, JSON, or HTML.
overview: Docling is an open-source document parsing toolkit started by IBM Research Zurich and now hosted by the Linux Foundation's AI & Data Foundation. It understands page layout, reading order, tables, formulas, and scanned-image OCR, converting PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, and even audio/video into a unified DoclingDocument you can export as Markdown, HTML, or lossless JSON. It is built for developers feeding clean document data into RAG pipelines and GenAI applications, and it runs fully locally for air-gapped environments.

docusign.verdict: E-signature and agreement management platform with AI contract analysis.
overview: DocuSign is the dominant e-signature platform used by millions of organizations to prepare, sign, and manage agreements online. Its built-in AI agreement analysis reviews contracts during the signing workflow, flagging risky clauses, missing terms, and deviations from standard language so teams can act before a document is finalized. Beyond signing, the platform offers agreement lifecycle management: templates, bulk sending, audit trails, identity verification, and integrations with CRMs and HR systems. Finance and legal teams use it to keep contracting inside a single governed workflow rather than scattered across inboxes.
